svg.text: श्रवणं कीर्तनं विष्णो: स्मरणं पादसेवनम् । अर्चनं वन्दनं दास्यं सख्यमात्मनिवेदनम्
śravaṇaṁ kīrtanaṁ viṣṇoḥ smaraṇaṁ pāda-sevanam / arcanaṁ vandanaṁ dāsyaṁ sakhyam ātma-nive
Hearing, chanting, remembering, serving the Lord's feet, worship, offering prayers, becoming a servant, friendship, and
KUTUMBA teaching meaning — not labeled as BBT translation
